id.description: The unique and required id of this instance.

data.description: JSON data associated with this report if any.

content.description: Binary content for the report if any.

dataType.description:
Optionally, the data type of the data associated with this report. This type is expected to be defined in
the client which will consume this report.

category.description: A category for report within the {@link #jarvisBuild} or {@link #step}.

subcategory.description:
A subcategory within {@link #category}.
Together with {@link #build}, {@link #step}, {@link #category}, this is the most granular way to identify
{@link Jarvis.Report}s without a specific id.

metricData.description: Lightweight data that can be used for calculating metrics.

jarvisBuild.description: The build this report was generated by.

step.description: The step this report was generated by.

parent.description:
The larger report this report belongs to.
Allows clients to report things incrementally rather than by overriding the parent, which could lead to merge
conflicts. The next time the parent is requested via {@link Jarvis#report}, all children will be merged into the
main report using {@link #amend}.

amend.description:
{@link Lambda} that specifies how to merge with this reports {@link #parent}.
Optionally specified when there is a parent

updates.description:
Any updates for this report that have not yet been merged in.
IMPORTANT: This is a READ only field. Specify {@link #parent} to populate this array.

title:
Represents a report for Jarvis. Reports can be used for storing arbitrary data structures for consumption in
client {@link App}s. This interface provides a standard way to persist arbitrary data over the course of a
build/ pipeline run. The pipeline author is free to use this interface however they wish.
name: Jarvis.Report
